items.title: KPMG Gives Tether Gold a Clean Audit Opinion
points: KPMG, a Big Four accounting firm, completed a full audit of Tether Gold's reserves and operations, issuing a clean opinion (meaning no material misstatements were found).
Each Tether Gold token is meant to represent one fine troy ounce of physical gold held in custody.

The audit boosts institutional confidence in Tether Gold as a gold-backed stablecoin (a cryptocurrency designed to hold a stable value, often pegged to an asset like gold or the dollar) and marks a step toward mainstream adoption of asset-backed digital tokens.

items.title: SEC Intervenes in Stock Perpetuals Regulatory Fight
points: Capital Markets Alliance, backed by Cboe and Citadel Securities, sued to overturn the CFTC's approval of stock perpetual contracts (leveraged derivatives letting traders bet on stock price moves), arguing it violated the Administrative Procedure Act and that the SEC should regulate instead.
The SEC filed an amicus brief rejecting the 'rogue CFTC' narrative, stating CFTC rule changes are subject to SEC review and that the agencies regularly collaborate on jurisdictional disputes.
The case highlights ongoing turf battles between regulators as crypto and traditional finance increasingly overlap.

items.title: AI-Powered Crime Task Force Tackles Crypto Fraud Explosion
points: Tron, Tether, and Chainalysis formed a Digital Crime Task Force to identify and disrupt illicit USDT activity, replacing the 2024 T3 Financial Crime Unit, which was disbanded over slow response times.
AI-enabled scams were 4.5x more profitable than conventional scams in 2025; impersonation scams jumped over 1,400%, with targets including terrorist financing and North Korean-linked attacks.
Tether has frozen over $7B in illicit assets, working with 360+ law enforcement agencies across 73 countries to shorten detection-to-enforcement timelines.

items.title: Ethereum's Elastic Parameters Could Improve Network Scaling
points: An Ethresear.ch proposal suggests replacing fixed slot times and gas limits with measurement-driven adaptive parameters, modeled on TCP's congestion control (a networking technique that adjusts data flow based on real-time conditions).

Telemetry from 233 nodes shows median block propagation reaches 95% of nodes in 0.38 seconds, but late-arrival rates range from 1.7% (company-run nodes) to 11.0% (individual contributor nodes); larger blocks take 0.61s to propagate vs. 0.34s for smaller ones.
Proposed adaptive mechanisms include dynamic slot timing (EIP-7782/EIP-8198), gas-limit voting, parallel block processing (Rapidblocks), and mempool aggregation (EIP-8288).

items.title: New Products Expand Crypto Infrastructure for AI Agents and RWAs
points: Circle's Agentic Works published experimental AI agent workflows, including autonomous agents making live football predictions and self-provisioning persistent crypto wallets across sessions.

Treasures Swap launched as a DEX (decentralized exchange) aggregator for tokenized equities (real-world stocks issued on blockchain), comparing pricing across issuers like Ondo, Dinari, and Backed to address price fragmentation across chains.
Rain Agent Vaults lets developers embed white-label AI agent spending accounts into their apps while retaining brand ownership and customer economics.
